response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates strong foundational software engineering experience spanning 20 years and meets the minimum 15-year requirement. However, this Principal Engineer role is specifically focused on AI Strategy, and he falls significantly short in demonstrated AI/ML expertise—the core specialization. While his recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks at re:cinq (since April 2025) shows emerging interest, it is insufficient to establish the deep, battle-tested AI expertise and recognized AI products/platforms required for this director-level position.
strengths: 20 years of broad software engineering expertise across web, mobile, desktop, and infrastructure with demonstrated technical depth in multiple programming languages and platforms
Proven engineering leadership through staff-level roles, founding GISCollective, mentoring, public conference talks, and creating workshops—showing ability to drive innovation and inspire teams
Strong cloud and full-stack developer capabilities including AWS CDK, Docker, Kubernetes, and multi-language proficiency, enabling rapid technical problem-solving
concerns: Minimal demonstrated AI/ML expertise; recent AI-agent infrastructure work at re:cinq is too nascent to establish the deep, proven AI specialization required for a principal-level AI strategy role
Lacks preferred Master's or PhD in AI-related field and shows no evidence of building recognized AI products, platforms, or publishing AI research
Career trajectory emphasizes technical execution and mentorship rather than the organizational strategic influence and customer advisory leadership typical of director-level principal engineers
